name: SkillsBench
intro: SkillsBench v1.1 用87项、8领域的真实专业任务和确定性验证器，对比无Skills与专家Skills条件，测量程序性技能包对智能体完成任务的实际增益。
org: BenchFlow, Ohio State University, Amazon, Dartmouth College, Stanford University, UC Davis, Carnegie Mellon University, UC Berkeley, and collaborators
build_method: 400份贡献者任务筛选, Oracle百分百验证, 来源与泄漏门禁, 维护者审查
metric: Task-macro Pass Rate, Skill Lift, Normalized Gain
eval_feature: 无Skills与专家Skills配对, 18种模型harness配置, 每题3次, 确定性验证
scale: 87项任务, 8个领域, 18种模型harness配置, 9396个主条件结果槽位
intro_en: SkillsBench v1.1 measures the practical lift from procedural Skill packages using 87 authentic professional tasks across eight domains, paired no-Skills versus curated-Skills conditions, and deterministic verifiers.
build_method_en: Filtering 400 contributed tasks with 100-percent oracle runs, provenance and leakage gates, and maintainer review
metric_en: Task-macro Pass Rate, Skill Lift, Normalized Gain
eval_feature_en: Matched no-Skills and curated-Skills conditions, 18 model-harness configurations, three trials per task, and deterministic verification
scale_en: 87 tasks, 8 domains, 18 model-harness configurations, 9,396 main-condition result slots

drawio_review_note: Aligned with SkillsBench arXiv:2602.12670 Sections 3-4 and Appendices B, D, and N; official benchflow-ai/skillsbench v1.1 repository. The current SkillsBench v1.1 paper builds 87 tasks across eight professional domains from 400 submissions by 142 contributors. Each task packages a human-authored instruction, pinned Docker environment and data, independently curated reusable Skills, a withheld oracle solution, and a deterministic pytest or checker verifier. Automated gates validate structure, require the oracle to pass 100 percent, screen instruction provenance, and reject Skill-to-solution leakage such as task-specific paths, magic numbers, oracle commands, or expected outputs. Maintainers then review realism, data, oracle and Skill quality, anti-cheating robustness, and whether Skills create measurable signal; 87 tasks survive. For each model-harness configuration, BenchFlow creates fresh pinned containers and runs matched no-Skills and curated-Skills conditions for three selected trials per task at temperature zero; a self-generated-Skills arm is reported separately for selected configurations. Deterministic pass/fail rewards are averaged within task and then macro-averaged across 87 tasks. The paper reports pass rate, absolute Skill lift, and normalized gain over 18 model-harness configurations.
